values.binNote: This is a wiki-computed sum of e_1 (base hit) plus one stack of e_2 (25% bonus), not a separate bin calculation; no dedicated row exists.

mechanics.claim: Sweeping Blade generates a stack of Ride the Wind for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits, stacking up to 4 times, and each stack increases Sweeping Blade's damage by 25%.
mechanics.quote: generates a stack of ''Ride the Wind'' for 5 seconds, which refreshes on subsequent hits and stacks up to 4 times

mechanics.claim: Sweeping Blade cannot be cast on the same target again for a per-target cooldown, starting upon starting the dash.
The ability's own cooldown starts after the dash ends, not at cast.
Yasuo becomes ghosted for 2 seconds on cast, refreshing on subsequent casts (defensive, not damage).
mechanics.quote: becomes {{tip|ghosted}} for 2 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts

mechanics.claim: Deals damage to the target upon impact of the dash, i.e. it is a single melee-range hit on arrival, not on cast.
mechanics.quote: Upon impact, he deals {{as|magic damage}} to the target
